evidence.quote: was prepared from commercial pure Mg (99.99 wt%) and Zn (99.95 wt%), Mg-30 wt% Gd and Mg-30 wt% Zr master alloys by semicontinuous casting technology under argon protection.
cylindrical billets with a size of F90 mm /C2 150 mm were machined from the cast ingot and then homogenized at 510 /C14 C for 20 h followed by air cooling.

These billets were preheated at each given extrusion temperature (ET, 360, 390, 420 and 450 /C14 C) for 2 h and forward extruded with four extrusion processes at a ram speed of 0.5 mm/s and extrusion ratio (ER) of 25:1 at all ETs and two extrusion processes at the same ram speed and ER of 9:1 at 360 and 390 /C14 C.

evidence.quote: These eutectic compounds are determined to be the Mg3Zn3-Gd2 phase (W-phase) with a face centered cubic (fcc) structure [29], combining Zn/Gd ratios in Table 2 for points A and B and the TEM images and the corresponding selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns in Fig. 4aec.
Almost all of the W phase is dissolved into the Mg matrix, while a large amount of the Zr-rich phase precipitates in the Mg matrix (Fig. 3d and Table 2).
Two types of Zr-rich phases are observed in the homogenization-treated alloy, i.e., the rod-like phase (green arrows in Fig. 4dee) and the blocky phase (yellow arrows in Fig. 4f).

The irregular granular-shaped second phase consists of Gd and Zn without Zr. These second phases are determined to be the W-phase. Compared with the Zn2Zr3 phase in the interior of the grains, the irregular granular-shaped W-phase has a significantly larger volume (~200 nm).

a large number of nanoprecipitated phases are distributed in the interior of the grains, and their average diameter and volume fraction are ~35 nm and ~2.0%, respectively. Other precipitated phases with larger sizes, whose volume fraction is about 4.0%, are mainly distributed at grain boundaries (GBs).

some second phases located at the edge of the W-phase exhibit spherical shapes, and these second phases consist of only Mg and Zr (Fig. 7f, marked by white ellipse). These second phases were determined to be Zr-rich phases.
